scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --force packages/client/ui-primitives packages/client/ui-conversation packages/client/ui-mermaid packages/client/modules && tsc -p packages/bundle/web-app
scripts.bundle: pnpm --dir packages/client/ui-primitives exec tsdown && pnpm --filter @dsh-mermaid-renderer/dsh-client-ui-conversation run bundle && pnpm --filter @dsh-mermaid-renderer/dsh-client-modules run bundle && pnpm --filter @dsh-mermaid-renderer/dsh-client-ui-mermaid run bundle && pnpm --dir packages/bundle/web-app exec tsdown -c ../../tools/web-app.tsdown.config.ts
